# Blondie's Saloon

> Blondie's Saloon is a neighborhood dive bar on Chapman Ave in Orange, CA with pool, electronic darts, beer on tap and sports on TV. Rated 4.3 on Google.

## About
Blondie's is one of Orange County's oldest neighborhood saloons, a dive bar tucked away on Chapman Ave in Orange. Whether you're a regular or walking in for the first time, the idea is simple: you should feel at home.
Come in for a beer on tap or in the bottle, rack up a game on one of the pool tables, try the electronic dart boards or Golden Tee golf, and watch sports on the flat screens. Wine and hard seltzers are on hand too. Blondie's holds a 4.3 rating from 179 Google reviews.
The house keeps things positive. Rude or violent behavior isn't tolerated, and if you've had too much to drive, Blondie's will arrange an Uber to get you home.

## Services
- Pool tables and Golden Tee golf: Two pool tables plus a Golden Tee golf game. One reviewer mentioned the two pool tables and said they enjoyed their time here.
- Electronic darts: 3 Phoenix electronic dart boards ready for a game.
- Beer, wine and hard seltzers: 12 beers on tap and 20 bottled beers, plus wine and hard seltzers. One reviewer recommends stopping in for a cold Pabst Blue Ribbon.
- Sports on the flat screens: Catch the game in HD on 10 flat screens.
- Service Industry Sundays: On Sunday evenings, Blondie's welcomes people who work in the service industry with drink specials.

## FAQ
Q: Who can come in?
A: Everyone over 21 is welcome, and you will be carded.

Q: What kind of ID do I need?
A: If you look under 30, be ready to show a legal ID with your description and picture on the same form.

Q: Is there a dress code?
A: Shoes and shirts are required. Club cuts, colors, patches, vests, support shirts, bandannas, hats and gang attire are not allowed.

Q: Can I bring my own drinks?
A: No. Outside alcoholic drinks aren't allowed inside, and drinks bought at the bar stay inside.
